resolution: Exposed the UV atlas total as editable width and height with one explicit Resize commit and a live X/Y ratio preview. Resize preserves normalized UV placement, retains workspace alpha, persists base.png, and is fully undoable/redoable. Invalid, over-GPU-limit, and over-preview-budget dimensions are rejected before resampling; an image layer's native-size readout can populate both fields in one click.
